Name: YouTube Music Web
Description: Control YouTube Music Web from your Elgato Stream Deck with real-time feedback, Dial support, and Discord Rich Presence.

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.playpause.Name: Play / Pause
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.playpause.Tooltip: Toggle Play / Pause (Hold to bring YouTube Music to foreground)

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.trackdial.Name: Track Controller (Dial)
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.trackdial.Tooltip: Stream Deck + Dial: rotate to skip tracks, press to toggle play/pause, view LCD feedback

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.volumedial.Name: Volume Controller (Dial)
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.volumedial.Tooltip: Stream Deck + Dial: rotate to adjust volume, press/touch to toggle mute, view volume feedback

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.seekdial.Name: Seek Controller (Dial)
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.seekdial.Tooltip: Stream Deck + Dial: rotate to seek forward / backward in track, press/touch to toggle play/pause, view live time & progress

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.mute.Name: Mute / Unmute
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.mute.Tooltip: Toggle mute state for currently playing track

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.prev.Name: Previous Track
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.prev.Tooltip: Skip to the previous track or restart current track

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.like.Name: Like Track
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.like.Tooltip: Toggle like rating for currently playing track

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.dislike.Name: Dislike Track
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.dislike.Tooltip: Toggle dislike rating for currently playing track

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.copyurl.Name: Copy Song URL
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.copyurl.Tooltip: Copy current song URL to clipboard

com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.seekforward.Name: Fast Forward
com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.seekforward.Tooltip: Fast forward playback by configured seconds

Localization.info.heading: Information
Localization.info.default_description: Controls active playback directly via local WebSocket.
Localization.controls.heading: Controls
Localization.tip.title: Tip
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.dislike.d: Toggles dislike (thumbs down) rating for the currently playing track.
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.like.desc: Toggles like (thumbs up) rating for the currently playing track.
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.next.desc: Skips immediately to the next track in the current queue.
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.prev.desc: Skips back to the previous track or restarts the current track.
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.mute.desc: Toggles mute state for active YouTube Music playback.
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.shuffle.d: Toggles queue shuffle mode on or off.
Localization.action.com.smok3y97.ytmusicweb.repeat.de: Cycles repeat modes: Off ➔ Repeat All ➔ Repeat One.
Localization.general.heading: General Settings
Localization.discord.rpc.label: Enable Discord Rich Presence
Localization.discord.rpc.hint: Broadcasts active playback and album art to Discord Desktop in real-time.
Localization.obs.group.title: OBS Overlay & Chatbot
Localization.obs.overlay.label: OBS Overlay
Localization.obs.overlay.hint: Add as Browser Source in OBS. Parameters: ?theme=card|compact|pill, ?accent=FF0033, ?hideOnPause=true.
Localization.chatbot.url.label: Chatbot URL
Localization.chatbot.url.hint: Use in local bots (Streamer.bot, MixItUp): http://localhost:39865/api/current for !song.
Localization.obs.export.heading: OBS Text Export (.txt)
Localization.obs.export.label: Enable OBS text export (.txt)
Localization.obs.export.hint: Writes track metadata to a local text file for OBS Text (GDI+) overlay sources.
Localization.obs.file.label: Text File
Localization.obs.file.required: ⚠️ File selection is required when OBS Text Export is enabled.
Localization.obs.file.hint: Select an existing or newly created .txt file on your computer.
Localization.obs.format.label: Format
Localization.obs.clear_on_pause.label: Clear text file when paused
Localization.advanced.group.title: Advanced Settings
Localization.language.label: Language
Localization.language.hint: Override the Property Inspector display language or use the Stream Deck system language.
Localization.discord.client_id.label: Discord Client ID
Localization.discord.client_id.hint: Custom Discord Application ID. Leave blank to use the official default.
Localization.marquee.speed.label: Marquee Speed
Localization.marquee.speed.hint: Text scroll speed for keys & dials (100ms – 600ms, Default: 320ms / ~3.1 Hz). Maximum 10 Hz rate limit.
Localization.server.port.label: Server Port
Localization.warning.outdated_extension: ⚠️ Browser Extension outdated! Please update to the latest version via GitHub Releases.
Localization.playpause.heading: Play / Pause Settings
Localization.playpause.cover_bg.label: Song cover as button background
Localization.playpause.cover_bg.hint: When enabled, the song cover of the current track is displayed directly on the button.
Localization.playpause.show_title.label: Show song info / time text on key
Localization.playpause.format.label: Text Format
Localization.playpause.tip.hint: 💡 Tip: To customize text position (Top, Middle, Bottom), font size, or text color, use the native Stream Deck "T" (Title Styler) button directly above this settings pane.
Localization.playpause.controls.hint:
• Short Press: Toggle Play / Pause
• Long Press (Hold): Bring YouTube Music / PWA to foreground
Localization.copyurl.heading: Copy Song URL Settings
Localization.copyurl.format.label: Copy Format
Localization.copyurl.format.hint:
Format template copied to your clipboard on key press.
Placeholders: {url}, {title}, {artist}, {album}, {duration}, {currentTime}.
Examples: {url}, {artist} - {title} ({url}), Now Playing: {artist} - {title}
Localization.copyurl.controls.hint:
• Key Press: Copy formatted song URL / track info to system clipboard
• Visual Feedback: Green checkmark icon confirms successful copy
Localization.seekdial.heading: Seek Dial Settings
Localization.seekdial.step.label: Seek Step
Localization.seekdial.step.hint: Seconds to scrub forward or backward per dial tick (5s – 120s, Default: 10s).
Localization.seekdial.title_template.label: Title Template
Localization.seekdial.time_template.label: Time Template
Localization.seekdial.show_cover.label: Show cover thumbnail on touchstrip
Localization.trackdial.heading: Track Dial Settings
Localization.volumedial.heading: Volume Dial Settings
Localization.volumedial.step.label: Step Size
Localization.volumedial.step.hint: Percentage amount adjusted per dial tick (5% – 50%, Default: 5%).
Localization.volumedial.title_template.label: Title Template
Localization.volumedial.title_template.hint: Placeholders: {artist}, {title}, {album} (or static title like YouTube Music Volume)
Localization.volume.heading: Volume Action Settings
Localization.volume.step.label: Step Size
Localization.volume.step.hint: Percentage amount to adjust per key press (5% – 50%, Default: 5%).
Localization.volume.show_text.label: Show volume text on key
Localization.volume.format.label: Volume Format
Localization.volume.tip.hint: 💡 Tip: To customize text position (Top, Middle, Bottom), font size, or text color, use the native Stream Deck "T" (Title Styler) button directly above this settings pane.
Localization.seek.heading: Seek Action Settings
Localization.seek.step.label: Seek Step

Localization.seek.format.label: Title Format
